title: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Dungeons, Formations, and Such

blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】ダンジョンとか陣形とか
blocks.translation: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Dungeons, Formations, and Such

blocks.source: あまりに特徴がなく適当だったダンジョンを強化することにしました。ピラミッドもどきです。
blocks.translation: I decided to enhance the dungeons, which had been far too bland and haphazard. It's a pyramid imitation.

blocks.source: 上に乗ると自動的に移動してしまうという斬新なトラップ。……いえ、ベタなのは重々承知。何もないよりはマシだと思ったので……。
blocks.translation: A novel trap that automatically moves you when you step on it. ...Well, I know full well it's cliché. I just thought it would be better than nothing...

blocks.source: 陣形を増やしました。町の本棚や宝箱から、さらに手に入ります。ちなみに、今回は会心の要素があります。運ゲー色が強いので、どちらかというとやや否定的だったのですが、なんだかんだいってあの気持ちよさは捨てがたいので、採用してみました。
blocks.translation: I added more formations. You can find even more in bookshelves and treasure chests in towns. This time, there are also critical hits. I was somewhat opposed to them since they make the game heavily luck-based, but that satisfying feeling is hard to give up, so I decided to include them.

blocks.source: もちろん会心率は魔珠やスキルで変動します。運の要素もある程度、制御できたほうが戦略性も高まるというもの。ＳＲＰＧの命中／回避率が良い例です。
blocks.translation: Naturally, your critical hit rate can be changed by mage orbs and skills. Being able to control the element of luck to some extent also increases the strategic depth. SRPG hit/evasion rates are a good example.

blocks.source: 宝箱の配置完了。店の設定完了。町人配置と大体完了。……ってな具合で着々と残りの作業が減って参りました。そろそろ、魔物データを設定しながらの通しプレイに入ってもよさそうです。
blocks.translation: The treasure chests are placed. The shops are set up. The townspeople are mostly in place. ...And so, the remaining work is steadily decreasing. It seems about time to start playing through the game while setting up the monster data.

blocks.source: 他の人の制作を見る限り『マップ』『イベント』『魔物データ＆バランス調整』などを並行しながら、作っていく人が多いのかなって気がします。制作途中で何度か体験版を出したりする人はこの型ですね。
blocks.translation: Judging from how other people develop their games, I get the impression that many of them work on things such as “Maps,” “Events,” and “Monster Data & Balance Adjustments” in parallel. People who release trial versions several times during development follow this approach.

blocks.source: が、僕の場合『マップ』『イベント』を先に作成し、『魔物データ＆バランス調整』は制作終盤に回すことが多いです。案外、珍しいやり方なのかもしれません。
blocks.translation: In my case, however, I usually create the “Maps” and “Events” first, and leave “Monster Data & Balance Adjustments” until the final stages of development. It may actually be a somewhat unusual approach.

blocks.source: こういう順番にする理由は主に二点。
blocks.translation: There are two main reasons for doing things in this order.

blocks.source: ストーリーを変更すると、バランスにも変動が発生するので、後でやったほうが無駄が少ない。具体的に影響する箇所は仲間の加入タイミング、ダンジョンの順番など。
blocks.translation: Changing the story also affects the balance, so doing it later results in less wasted effort. Specific areas affected include when party members join and the order of the dungeons.

blocks.source: 『マップ』や『イベント』と比べると『魔物データ＆バランス調整』は製作時間が短く、制作難易度が低い。簡単なところは後回しにしたほうが挫折しにくい。
blocks.translation: Compared to “Maps” and “Events,” “Monster Data & Balance Adjustments” takes less time to create and is less difficult. Postponing the easier tasks makes it less likely that you will give up.

blocks.source: ただし、戦闘バランスは後回しでよいとはいっても、戦闘システムなどの主要システムは先に構築しておいたほうがいいと思います。制作後半にいざシステム構築しようとした時に「技量が足りない！」ってなったら絶望的なので。要するに、詰まりそうなところは先にやろうって考えですね。
blocks.translation: However, although it is fine to leave battle balance until later, I think major systems such as the battle system should be built first. It would be devastating to reach the latter half of development and then discover that you don't have the skills to build the system. In short, my thinking is that you should tackle anything likely to cause a roadblock first.

blocks.source: ってなわけで、６１０時間消化です。
blocks.translation: And with that, I've put in 610 hours.
